title: Iran army spokesman describes shift to a more offensive military doctrine
content: An Iranian army brigadier general, speaking to Press TV, said the country's military posture has shifted from a defensive orientation toward a more offensive one. He pointed to the rapid retaliatory strikes carried out once the war began in late February and to pre-emptive operations conducted during the conflict as evidence of the change. He added that Iranian forces are rebuilding damaged systems, fielding new weapons and drones, and preparing for a longer, technology-driven conflict that could target regional energy and communications infrastructure if Iran is attacked again, describing the shift as intended to strengthen deterrence against the United States.
